name: Name
desc: Product name

name: Version
desc: Product version

name: Release_date
desc: Date of latest source code update

name: Nbthread
desc: Number of started threads (global.nbthread)

name: Nbproc
desc: Number of started worker processes (historical, always 1)

name: Process_num
desc: Relative worker process number (1)

name: Pid
desc: This worker process identifier for the system

name: Uptime
desc: How long ago this worker process was started (days+hours+minutes+seconds)

name: Uptime_sec
desc: How long ago this worker process was started (seconds)

name: Memmax_MB
desc: Worker process's hard limit on memory usage in MB (-m on command line)

name: PoolAlloc_MB
desc: Amount of memory allocated in pools (in MB)

name: PoolUsed_MB
desc: Amount of pool memory currently used (in MB)

name: PoolFailed
desc: Number of failed pool allocations since this worker was started

name: Ulimit-n
desc: Hard limit on the number of per-process file descriptors

name: Maxsock
desc: Hard limit on the number of per-process sockets

name: Maxconn
desc: Hard limit on the number of per-process connections (configured or imposed by Ulimit-n)

name: Hard_maxconn
desc: Hard limit on the number of per-process connections (imposed by Memmax_MB or Ulimit-n)

name: CurrConns
desc: Current number of connections on this worker process

name: CumConns
desc: Total number of connections on this worker process since started

name: CumReq
desc: Total number of requests on this worker process since started

name: MaxSslConns
desc: Hard limit on the number of per-process SSL endpoints (front+back), 0=unlimited

name: CurrSslConns
desc: Current number of SSL endpoints on this worker process (front+back)

name: CumSslConns
desc: Total number of SSL endpoints on this worker process since started (front+back)

name: Maxpipes
desc: Hard limit on the number of pipes for splicing, 0=unlimited

name: PipesUsed
desc: Current number of pipes in use in this worker process

name: PipesFree
desc: Current number of allocated and available pipes in this worker process

name: ConnRate
desc: Number of front connections created on this worker process over the last second

name: ConnRateLimit
desc: Hard limit for ConnRate (global.maxconnrate)

name: MaxConnRate
desc: Highest ConnRate reached on this worker process since started (in connections per second)

name: SessRate
desc: Number of sessions created on this worker process over the last second

name: SessRateLimit
desc: Hard limit for SessRate (global.maxsessrate)

name: MaxSessRate
desc: Highest SessRate reached on this worker process since started (in sessions per second)

name: SslRate
desc: Number of SSL connections created on this worker process over the last second

name: SslRateLimit
desc: Hard limit for SslRate (global.maxsslrate)

name: MaxSslRate
desc: Highest SslRate reached on this worker process since started (in connections per second)

name: SslFrontendKeyRate
desc: Number of SSL keys created on frontends in this worker process over the last second

name: SslFrontendMaxKeyRate
desc: Highest SslFrontendKeyRate reached on this worker process since started (in SSL keys per second)

name: SslFrontendSessionReuse_pct
desc: Percent of frontend SSL connections which did not require a new key

name: SslBackendKeyRate
desc: Number of SSL keys created on backends in this worker process over the last second

name: SslBackendMaxKeyRate
desc: Highest SslBackendKeyRate reached on this worker process since started (in SSL keys per second)

name: SslCacheLookups
desc: Total number of SSL session ID lookups in the SSL session cache on this worker since started

name: SslCacheMisses
desc: Total number of SSL session ID lookups that didn't find a session in the SSL session cache on this worker since started

name: CompressBpsIn
desc: Number of bytes submitted to the HTTP compressor in this worker process over the last second

name: CompressBpsOut
desc: Number of bytes emitted by the HTTP compressor in this worker process over the last second

name: CompressBpsRateLim
desc: Limit of CompressBpsOut beyond which HTTP compression is automatically disabled

name: ZlibMemUsage
desc: Amount of memory currently used by HTTP compression on the current worker process (in bytes)

name: MaxZlibMemUsage
desc: Limit on the amount of memory used by HTTP compression above which it is automatically disabled (in bytes, see global.maxzlibmem)

name: Tasks
desc: Total number of tasks in the current worker process (active + sleeping)

name: Run_queue
desc: Total number of active tasks+tasklets in the current worker process

name: Idle_pct
desc: Percentage of last second spent waiting in the current worker thread

name: node
desc: Node name (global.node)

name: description
desc: Node description (global.description)

name: Stopping
desc: 1 if the worker process is currently stopping, otherwise zero

name: Jobs
desc: Current number of active jobs on the current worker process (frontend connections, master connections, listeners)

name: Unstoppable Jobs
desc: Current number of unstoppable jobs on the current worker process (master connections)

name: Listeners
desc: Current number of active listeners on the current worker process

name: ActivePeers
desc: Current number of verified active peers connections on the current worker process

name: ConnectedPeers
desc: Current number of peers having passed the connection step on the current worker process

name: DroppedLogs
desc: Total number of dropped logs for current worker process since started

name: BusyPolling
desc: 1 if busy-polling is currently in use on the worker process, otherwise zero (config.busy-polling)

name: FailedResolutions
desc: Total number of failed DNS resolutions in current worker process since started

name: TotalBytesOut
desc: Total number of bytes emitted by current worker process since started

name: TotalSplicedBytesOut
desc: Total number of bytes emitted by current worker process through a kernel pipe since started

name: BytesOutRate
desc: Number of bytes emitted by current worker process over the last second

name: DebugCommandsIssued
desc: Number of debug commands issued on this process (anything > 0 is unsafe)

name: CumRecvLogs
desc: Total number of log messages received by log-forwarding listeners on this worker process since started

name: Build info
desc: Build info

name: Memmax_bytes
desc: Worker process's hard limit on memory usage in bytes (-m on command line)

name: PoolAlloc_bytes
desc: Amount of memory allocated in pools (in bytes)

name: PoolUsed_bytes
desc: Amount of pool memory currently used (in bytes)

name: Start_time_sec
desc: Start time in seconds

name: Tainted
desc: Experimental features used

name: TotalWarnings
desc: Total warnings issued

name: MaxconnReached
desc: Number of times an accepted connection resulted in Maxconn being reached

name: BootTime_ms
desc: How long ago it took to parse and process the config before being ready (milliseconds)

name: Niced_tasks
desc: Total number of active tasks+tasklets in the current worker process (Run_queue) that are niced

name: CurrStreams
desc: Current number of streams on this worker process

name: CumStreams
desc: Total number of streams created on this worker process since started

name: BlockedTrafficWarnings
desc: Total number of warnings issued about traffic being blocked by too slow a task

name: PatternsAdded
desc: Total number of patterns added (acl/map entries)

name: PatternsFreed
desc: Total number of patterns freed (acl/map entries)

name: NbThreadGroups
desc: Number of started thread groups (global.thread-groups)

name: Master_id
desc: Unique identifier of the master process, preserved across reloads (master-worker mode only)

name: Worker_id
desc: Unique identifier of this worker process, renewed on each reload unless set with global 'worker-id'
